security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost https://asset.localhost; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Local-first notes with built-in semantic search and AI chat.
bundle.longDescription: Skein is a local-first note-taking app: markdown files in a folder you own, with semantic search, RAG-backed chat, daily notes, image attachments, and optional git sync — all running entirely on your machine.
